UC.name: Underpayment Processing
UC.summary: Automate root-cause research for underpaid claims by comparing Epic billing/build data, contract rate sheets, and payer EOB/835 data, presenting findings for analyst approval through a human-in-the-loop review, and supporting downstream appeal letter preparation.

opportunity.title: AI-Forward Contract & Underpayment Research
opportunity.body: Automate cross-referencing of Epic build data, contract/rate summary sheets, and OnBase/payer-portal EOBs to identify the likely underpayment root cause (rate/build issue, CPT downcode, bundling misapplication, non-billed item, or true denial).

opportunity.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review
opportunity.body: Present findings via an Action Center-style interface for analyst approval/rejection, with the system learning from analyst decisions over time.

opportunity.title: Appeal Letter Drafting
opportunity.body: Once a contract analysis is approved, automatically draft a payer-specific appeal/reconsideration letter for analyst final review.

opportunity.title: (Future phase) Claim Status / Leak Detection
opportunity.body: Automate payer-portal checks (~30–35 days post-submission) to detect claims that have not yet been paid.

outcomes.title: Reduce Manual Root-Cause Research Time
outcomes.body: Automate the multi-system comparison that currently drives the majority of per-case handling time.

outcomes.title: Codify Tribal Knowledge
outcomes.body: Convert payer-specific patterns (downcoding, bundling) into documented, checkable rules.

outcomes.title: Improve Recovery Capture
outcomes.body: Reduce cases going unworked due to current under-resourcing (3 analysts).

outcomes.title: Establish a Measurable Baseline
outcomes.body: Create the volume/handling-time data needed to benchmark improvement, which does not exist today.
